answer: A Brakedown commitment encodes data with a linear-time error-correcting code and proves an evaluation by opening a few encoded positions, keeping prover work fast and proofs compact. A terrace of fake codewords collapses under sampling, the shale of a forged encoding cracks because random positions reveal it is not a valid codeword, and the vault of the commitment only opens when the sampled positions agree with the claimed evaluation.
